source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid rectangle is the object; other non-background cells are direction markers.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v)
    color = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, color)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        left_block = any(rr == r and cc < c0 for rr, cc in markers)
        right_block = any(rr == r and cc > c1 for rr, cc in markers)
        left = c0 if left_block else 0
        right = c1 if right_block else w - 1
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = color
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        top_block = any(cc == c and rr < r0 for rr, cc in markers)
        bottom_block = any(cc == c and rr > r1 for rr, cc in markers)
        top = r0 if top_block else 0
        bottom = r1 if bottom_block else h - 1
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
